name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: Trump says he won't rule out sending ground troops to Iran
changes.summary: President Trump told Fox News on Tuesday that he won't rule out a ground invasion of Iran. The comments come amid another round of U.S. strikes against Iranian targets. CBS News' Eleanor Watson reports.

changes.title: After ICE fatally shot multiple people, officials speak out: "We want them out"
changes.summary: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officials shot and killed two men in the last week in Maine and in Texas. Maine's House speaker, a Houston prosecutor and a Minnesota attorney spoke with CBS News about the violence.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche to appear for confirmation hearing, U.S. restarts blockade against Iran amid standoff over the Strait of Hormuz, ICE suspends traffic stops after deadly shootings.

changes.title: CDC director nominee Erica Schwartz faces Senate for confirmation hearing
changes.summary: Dr. Erica Schwartz, Trump's nominee for CDC director, faces the Senate health committee for her confirmation hearing on July 15. If confirmed, she will lead an agency dealing with workforce and leadership shortages, and new layers of political review. (Image credit: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services).

changes.title: Wildfires expose millions in the Midwest and Northeast US to dangerous smoke
changes.summary: Heavy smoke from several large wildfires blazing in Canada and Minnesota is expected to engulf large swaths of the Midwest and Northeast U.S. this week, exposing millions of people to dangerous air pollution.

changes.title: For Israel, the U.S.-Iran Hostilities Have Created an Uneasy Limbo
changes.summary: Officials see a return to full-blown war as preferable to an agreement that fails to curb the threats Iran poses to Israel. Meanwhile, they wait.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: The parasite, which has sickened thousands across the U.S., is notoriously difficult to track. Funding cuts haven’t made the job easier.

changes.title: Jay Clayton Expected to Face Tough Questions in Confirmation Hearing
changes.summary: His nomination to lead the U.S. intelligence community comes as the White House pushes to use declassified intelligence to show concerns about election security.

changes.title: Some international artists are skipping U.S. tours. Others may follow suit
changes.summary: The visa process for visiting artists has always been complicated and expensive. Under the current administration, it's gotten significantly worse.
